\section{Sorting by repeated exchange}

\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Exchange sort of an invented list.}
\label{alg:exchange}
\LinesNumbered
\KwIn{a list $L$ of $n$ invented weights}
\KwOut{the same list, lightest first}
\For{$i \gets 1$ \KwTo $n$}{
  \tcc{one pass floats the heaviest weight to the end}
  \For{$j \gets 1$ \KwTo $n - i$}{
    \eIf{$L_j > L_{j+1}$}{
      swap $L_j$ and $L_{j+1}$\;
    }{
      keep the pair as it stands\;
    }
  }
}
\Return{$L$}\;
\end{algorithm}

Algorithm~\ref{alg:exchange} is restated below in the algorithmicx
spelling; both spellings parse onto the same lines.

\begin{algorithm}
\caption{The same exchange sort, algorithmicx spelling.}
\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\Require a list $L$ of $n$ invented weights
\Ensure the same list, lightest first
\For{$i = 1, \dots, n$}
  \For{$j = 1, \dots, n - i$}
    \If{$L_j > L_{j+1}$}
      \State swap $L_j$ and $L_{j+1}$ \Comment{exchange the pair}
    \EndIf
  \EndFor
\EndFor
\State \Return $L$
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
